## Video Tutorial

{{< video https://youtu.be/yUNZya20hNo?feature=shared >}}

## In this tutorial

A quick guide to making a map in QGIS with symbols graduated by size. Via [Easy Gisy](https://www.youtube.com/@easygisy) on Youtube.

**Timestamps (Click a link to start that segment in a new window)**

[0:00-1:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yUNZya20hNo): Open up Attribute Table to view your data

[1:11-2:15](https://youtu.be/yUNZya20hNo?si=kLb7zpBay8IGmy1t&t=71): Double click on the layer you want to symbolize to open up Properties, click Symbology, then Graduated, select the column you want to visualize, and select "Size" for the method.

[2:15-4:53](https://youtu.be/yUNZya20hNo?si=RScmFRmtrgBI41El): Options to change the size range of your points, the number of classes, the color, opacity, outlines, and number of decimals in the legend.
